text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest gains, with BTC and ETH nearly matched at +1.1% and +1.2% respectively, suggesting relatively balanced strength between the two majors rather than rotation pressure. The Fear & Greed index at 28 indicates underlying caution despite the price moves, with only marginal improvement over the week, pointing to persistent uncertainty despite stabilization. BTC dominance holding firm at 56.5% and $38B in daily volume suggest traders are present but not aggressive, consistent with a consolidation phase rather than conviction buying.
